notes.subject: שפל
notes.rationale: Root שׁפל appears twice — תשפילנו 'humbles him' and שפל־רוח 'lowly of spirit' — the verse pivots on one root; partly kept with 'daunabelim'/'ruak daun'.

notes.subject: יתמך כבוד
notes.rationale: YLT reads 'humility upholdeth honour' (honour as subject); most read honour upholds the humble — the latter is followed.

notes.subject: ruak
notes.rationale: רוח is wind/breath/spirit, kept as 'ruak' per the fixed gloss rather than 'spirit'.

translation: Hailait bilong man bai i daunabelim ⟨את⟩ em, tasol man i gat ruak daun bai ol i holim gutpela ⟨את⟩ nem bilong em.

tokens.gloss: tasol man i gat ruak daun
